title: Aggression
gametext:
While you have initiative, each Dwarf is damage +1.
Fellowship: Spot a Dwarf who is damage +X to draw X cards. Discard this condition.
lore: 'Certainty of death, small chance of success....'

title: Battle in Earnest
gametext: Spot a Dwarf who is damage +X to place X wounds on minions.
lore: '...they laughed when they looked on us, for they were a great army still.'

title: Blood Runs Chill
gametext: Spot a Dwarf who is damage +X and exert that Dwarf twice to make an opponent discard X Shadow cards.
lore: ...the Dark Door gaped before them like the mouth of night.

title: Counts But One
gametext: If Gimli is not assigned to a skirmish, add a threat to have him replace an unbound companion in a skirmish.
lore: '...no matter how big.'

title: Gimli
gametext:
Damage +1.
For each wound on Gimli, he is strength +1 and damage +1.
lore: Twenty, twenty-one, twenty-two....
subtitle: Counter of Foes

title: Honed
gametext: Spot a Dwarf who is damage +X to make him strength +X.
lore: 'What are we waiting for?'

title: Unheard of
gametext: If a Dwarf who is damage +X wins a skirmish, wound a minion not assigned to a skirmish X times.
lore: '...an Elf will go underground and a Dwarf dare not.'

title: Wish For Our Kinfolk
gametext:
Fellowship: Exert a Dwarf companion and either an [elven] companion or a [gondor] Man to add a [dwarven] token here.
Skirmish: Remove a [dwarven] token here to make a companion damage +1.
lore: '...war already marches on their own lands.'

title: A Grey Ship
gametext: Spot an Elf companion and make the fellowship archery total -X (to a minimum of 0) to heal X unbound companions. You cannot use archery special abilities.
lore: '...full of ghosts.'

title: Legolas
gametext:
Archer.
While you can spot 3 wounded minions, each minion skirmishing Legolas is strength -3.
lore: ...Legolas of the Elves, for whom the ghosts of Men have no terror.
subtitle: Elven Stalwart

title: Life of the Eldar
gametext:
To play, spot 2 Elves.
Discard an Elf to draw 3 cards.
lore: 'Your hands are cold....'

title: Reckless We Rode
gametext: Exert an Elf companion and make the fellowship archery total -X (to a minimum of 0) to wound a minion X times. You cannot use archery special abilities.
lore: '...driving them like leaves....'

title: Shake Off the Shadow
gametext:
Fellowship: Exert an Elf companion and either a [gandalf] companion or a [dwarven] companion to add an [elven] token here.
Archery: Remove an [elven] token here to make the fellowship archery total +1 (limit +2).
lore: 'Speak and be comforted....'

title: A Fool
gametext: At sites 1[K] to 5[K], heal Gandalf. At any other site, prevent a Hobbit from being overwhelmed unless his or her strength is tripled.
lore: '...but an honest fool he remains.'

title: Gandalf
gametext: When Gandalf is in your starting fellowship, his twilight cost is -2.
lore: '...the rule of no realm is mine, neither of Gondor nor any other, great or small.'
subtitle: Leader of Men

title: Let Us Not Tarry
gametext: Exert Gandalf to make a minion skirmishing an unbound companion strength -1 for each Gandalf signet you spot.
lore: 'There is much to say and to do, and you are weary.'

title: Mighty Steed
gametext: If Gandalf is not assigned to a skirmish, spot Shadowfax or exert Gandalf to have Gandalf replace an unbound companion in a skirmish.
lore: 'He always turns up when things are darkest. Go on! Go on, White Rider! Gandalf! Gandalf!'

title: Not the First Halfling
gametext:
Fellowship: Exert Gandalf and either an [elven] companion or a [shire] companion to add a [gandalf] token here.
Skirmish: Remove a [gandalf] token here to make a minion skirmishing an unbound companion strength -2.

title: On Your Doorstep
gametext: Spot Gandalf and exert a companion to place a card of that companion's culture from your discard pile on top of your draw deck.
lore: 'Lord Denethor is a Steward only.'

title: Saved From the Fire
gametext: Spot Gandalf and place a companion (except the Ring-bearer) in the dead pile to take up to 3 cards from that companion's culture into hand from your draw deck. Shuffle your draw deck.
lore: '...we will bear Faramir, Steward of Gondor, to a place where he can sleep in peace....'

title: Shadowfax
gametext:
Bearer must be Gandalf.
At the start of each skirmish involving Gandalf, each minion skirmishing Gandalf must exert.
Skirmish: Add a threat to make Gandalf strength +1.
subtitle: Greatheart

title: Hidden Even From Her
gametext:
Gollum is fierce.
Shadow: Spot 6 companions to play Gollum from your discard pile and exert a companion. Place this condition on top of your draw deck.
lore: ...even when he had come to her again and had bowed low....

title: Larder
gametext:
To play, spot a [gollum] minion.
Regroup: Discard an Orc from hand to add a [gollum] token here.
Skirmish: Remove a [gollum] token here to make Shelob strength +3 (limit +6).
lore: 'When she binds with cords, she's after meat.'

title: Promise Keeping
gametext: Each time a companion takes a wound during a skirmish that involves a [gollum] minion, exert a companion.
lore: 'And we'll save the Precious, as we promised.... Then we'll pay everyone back!'

title: Shelob
gametext:
Fierce.
When you play Shelob, you may play a [gollum] possession from your draw deck.
Shelob is strength +3 for each minion stacked on a [gollum] possession.
lore: ...who only desired death for all others....
subtitle: Eater of Light

title: Shelob
gametext:
Enduring. Fierce.
While in a fierce skirmish, Shelob is damage +1.
lore: ...for all living things were her food, and her vomit darkness.
subtitle: Last Child of Ungoliant

title: Sméagol
gametext:
Ring-bound. To play, add a burden.
Skirmish: Add threats equal to the total vitality of the minions Sméagol is skirmishing to discard Sméagol.
Regroup: Discard Sméagol to take a [gollum] minion from your discard pile into hand.
subtitle: Slippery Sneak

title: Spider Poison
gametext:
Skirmish: Remove a threat or a burden to transfer this possession to a companion skirmishing Shelob.
Each time bearer is assigned to a skirmish, bearer must exert.
lore: He lay now pale, and heard no voice, and did not move.

title: Still Far Ahead
gametext: Spot Sméagol to play the fellowship's next site (replacing opponent's site if necessary). The Shadow number of the fellowship's next site is -1 until the end of the turn.
lore: ...the very crown of this bitter road.

title: Web
gametext:
Regroup: If there are fewer than 3 cards stacked here, spot your Orc or [gollum] minion to stack that minion here.
Shadow: Play a [gollum] minion stacked here as if played from hand.
lore: 'Caught in a web. Soon he'll be eaten!'

title: At His Command
gametext: Exert Aragorn to make an unbound companion with the Aragorn signet strength +1 for each threat you spot.
lore: 'Even the shades of Men are obedient to his will....'

title: Catapult
gametext:
To play, spot 2 [gondor] knights.
Maneuver: Discard 2 cards from hand to reveal the top card of an opponent's draw deck. Choose an opponent who must discard a Shadow card that has a twilight cost that is the same as the twilight cost of the revealed card.

title: Elessar's Edict
gametext: If a [gondor] Wraith is about to be killed, discard him and either exhaust another [gondor] Wraith or spot another exhausted [gondor] Wraith to prevent that.
lore: 'Yes, the Dead ride behind. They have been summoned....'

title: Faramir
gametext:
Knight.
When you play Faramir (except in your starting fellowship), you may reveal the top 10 cards of your draw deck. You may play a knight revealed. Shuffle your draw deck.
lore: '...I will go and do what I can in his stead – if you command it.'
subtitle: Defender of Osgiliath

title: Fourth Level
gametext:
Fortification.
Skirmish: Exert 2 [gondor] Men or spot 3 knights to transfer this condition from your support area to a minion skirmishing a [gondor] Man. Exhaust that minion.
lore: ...about each was set a wall....

title: Garrison of Gondor
gametext:
Knight. Archer.
To play, spot 3 [gondor] companions.
While you can spot a fortification, Garrison of Gondor is defender +1.
lore: But about the Gate resistance still was stout....

title: Imrahil
gametext:
Knight. To play, spot a knight.
Each time Imrahil wins a skirmish, you may exert 2 minions.
lore: ...he was of high blood, and his folk also, tall men and proud with sea-grey eyes.
subtitle: Prince of Dol Amroth

title: King of the Dead
gametext:
Enduring. To play, spot a [gondor] Wraith and add 2 threats.
Response: If Aragorn is about to take a wound in a skirmish, exert King of the Dead to prevent that wound.
lore: '...crying out that the King of the Dead was upon them.'
subtitle: Oathbreaker

title: Knight of Dol Amroth
gametext:
Knight.
Each time this companion wins a skirmish, you may wound a minion he is skirmishing.
lore: Amroth for Gondor!' they cried.

title: Knight's Mount
gametext:
Bearer must be a knight.
Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may wound a minion who is not assigned to a skirmish.
lore: Like thunder they broke upon the enemy....

title: Oathbreaker
gametext:
Enduring. To play, add a threat.
Skirmish: Discard 3 cards from hand to discard a possession borne by a minion skirmishing this companion.
lore: at the Stone of Erech they shall stand again / and hear there a horn in the hills ringing.

title: A Path Appointed
gametext:
Fellowship: Exert a [gondor] Man and either a [dwarven] companion or a [rohan] companion to add a [gondor] token here.
Regroup: Remove a [gondor] token here to discard a minion.
lore: '...those who follow me do so of their free will....'

title: Shadow Host
gametext:
Enduring. To play, spot 2 exhausted [gondor] Wraiths and add 2 threats.
While Shadow Host is exhausted, it is defender +1.
lore: ...fear went on before them, until they came to Calembel upon Ciril, and the sun went down like blood behind Pinnath Gelin....

title: Sixth Level
gametext:
Fortification.
Regroup: Exert a [gondor] Man to play a [gondor] fortification from your discard pile (limit 1).
lore: ...and in each wall was a gate.

title: Sleepless Dead
gametext:
Enduring. To play, add a threat.
Each time this companion wins a skirmish, you may exert him to discard a minion he is skirmishing.
lore: '...for the Dead needed no longer any weapon but fear. None would withstand them.'

title: Spectral Sword
gametext:
Bearer must be a [gondor] Wraith.
Skirmish: Discard 3 cards from hand to heal bearer.
lore: '...pale banners like shreds of cloud, and spears like winter-thickets on a misty night.'

title: Stronger and More Terrible
gametext:
To play, add a threat.
Each time your [gondor] Wraith wins a skirmish, you may remove a threat.
lore: 'And lo! in the darkness of Mordor my hope rose....'

title: Swept Away
gametext:
Each time the fellowship moves, add a threat or discard this condition.
While you have initiative, exhausted [gondor] Wraiths cannot take wounds.
lore: 'And suddenly the Shadow Host that had hung back at the last came up like a grey tide, sweeping all away before it.'

title: Black Númenorean
gametext:
Corsair. Fierce.
Skirmish: If you have initiative, remove a [raider] token to discard a possession borne by a character skirmishing this minion.
lore: ...corrupted by Sauron, and who hated above all the followers of Elendil.

title: Black Sails of Umbar
gametext:
When you play this possession, you may add a [raider] token here.
Shadow: Remove X [raider] tokens here to play a corsair from your discard pile; its twilight cost is -X. Discard this possession.

cost.text: Choose how many {raider} tokens to remove

title: Castamir of Umbar
gametext:
Corsair. Enduring. Fierce.
Shadow: Exert Castamir of Umbar and play a corsair to add 2 [raider] tokens to a card that already has a [raider] token on it.
lore: 'They have long ceased to fear the might of Gondor.'

title: Corsair Ballista
gametext:
Bearer must be a corsair.
While you have initiative, bearer is an archer and fierce.
lore: Ranged weapons bristled from the warships and aided the Corsairs' plunder of coastal cities.

title: Corsair Buccaneer
gametext:
Corsair.
When you play this minion, you may remove a threat to add 2 [raider] tokens to a card that already has a [raider] token on it.
lore: '...a great fleet drawing near to the mouths of Anduin....'

title: Corsair Freebooter
gametext:
Corsair.
When you play this minion, you may remove 2 culture tokens to add 2 [raider] tokens to a card that already has a [raider] token on it.
lore: ...the strength of the rebels in Umbar was a great peril to Gondor....

title: Corsair Gunners
gametext:
Corsair.
Skirmish: If you have initiative, remove a [raider] token to make a corsair fierce until the regroup phase.
lore: 'The Corsairs are upon us!'

title: Corsair Lookout
gametext:
Corsair.
When you play this minion, if you have initiative, you may discard an ally to add 2 [raider] tokens to a card that already has a [raider] token on it.
lore: ...watchmen on the walls saw afar a new sight of fear, and their last hope left them.

title: Corsair Marauder
gametext:
Corsair.
When you play this minion, if you can spot another corsair, you may discard a possession to add 2 [raider] tokens to a card that already has a [raider] token on it.
lore: Umbar remained at war with Gondor for many lives of men....

title: Corsair Plunderer
gametext:
Corsair.
When you play this minion, you may discard 2 cards from hand to add 2 [raider] tokens to a card that already has a [raider] token on it.
lore: ...Umbar... fell into the hands of the Men of Harad.

title: Corsair War Galley
gametext:
When you play this possession, you may add a [raider] token here.
While you can spot 6 [raider] tokens and a [raider] Man, the Shadow has initiative, regardless of the Free Peoples player's hand.
Regroup: Add (1) for each [raider] token you can spot. Discard this possession.

title: Haradrim Marksman
gametext:
Southron. Archer.
While you can spot another [raider] Man, Ring-bound companions cannot take archery wounds.
lore: Archers from Harad rode atop the great war-beasts on the Fields of Pelennor.

title: Haradwaith
gametext:
While you can spot a [raider] minion at site 4[K], the Shadow has initiative, regardless of the Free Peoples player's hand.
Response: If a companion is played, discard a [raider] card from hand to add (5). Discard this condition.

title: Heavy Axeman
gametext:
Easterling.
While you can spot 4 burdens, Heavy Axeman is strength +4 and fierce.
lore: ...the Easterlings were strong and war-hardened and asked for no quarter.

title: Line of Defense
gametext: While you can spot a mounted [raider] Man, [raider] Men cannot take wounds (except during skirmishes).
lore: ...and stood like towers of defence....

title: Mûmakil
gametext:
Bearer must be a Southron.
Bearer is fierce.
While you have initiative or can spot 4 threats, bearer is damage +1.
lore: But wherever the mûmakil came there the horses would not go, but blenched and swerved away....

title: Ships of Great Draught
gametext:
Shadow: Remove a threat or discard a [raider] card from hand to add a [raider] token here.
Regroup: Remove 2 [raider] tokens here to place a [raider] card from your discard pile on top of your draw deck.

title: Wind That Sped Ships
gametext: Make a corsair strength +1 for each [raider] token you spot (limit +6). If you have initiative, you may place this event on top of your draw deck.
lore: ...black against the glittering stream... a fleet borne up on the wind....

effect.text: Choose how many {raider} tokens to spot

true.text: Would you like to place {self} on top of your draw deck?

title: Between Nazgûl and Prey
gametext: Exert an enduring [wraith] minion twice to assign that minion to an unbound companion.
lore: ...the Nazgûl Lord like a shadow of despair.

title: Beyond All Darkness
gametext: Exert a Nazgûl to make him strength +2 and damage +1. If the character he is skirmishing is killed, the Free Peoples player must place his or her hand beneath his or her draw deck.
lore: '...where thy flesh shall be devoured....'

title: Black Dart
gametext:
Archery: Spot your enduring or mounted Nazgûl to transfer this condition from your support area to an unbound companion. Discard a mount borne by that companion.
Bearer cannot heal or bear mounts.

title: Black Flail
gametext:
Bearer must be a Nazgûl.
Skirmish: If bearer is The Witch-king, exert him and spot a possession borne by a character he is skirmishing to discard that possession.
lore: With a cry of hatred that stung the very ears like venom he let fall....

title: Flung Into the Fray
gametext:
When you play a minion stacked here, you may exert a companion.
Regroup: If no minion is stacked here, spot your [wraith] minion to stack it here.
Shadow: Spot 2 [wraith] minions to play a [wraith] minion stacked here as if played from hand.

title: Gothmog
gametext: While you have initiative, each [wraith] minion is an archer.
lore: 'The age of Men is over.'
subtitle: Morgul Commander

title: Mastered By Madness
gametext: Make a Nazgûl strength +2. If that Nazgûl wins this skirmish, you may discard a Free Peoples mount.
lore: ...then Windfola had thrown them in his terror, and now ran wild upon the plain.

title: Morgul Ambusher
gametext: While you can spot 3 threats, the minion archery total is +2.
lore: 'Fear, the City is rank with it.'

title: Morgul Creeper
gametext: While you can spot 3 burdens, the minion archery total is +2.
lore: 'Kill all in your path!'

title: Morgul Lurker
gametext: While you have initiative, the minion archery total is +2.
lore: 'The time of the Orc has come.'

title: Morgul Squealer
gametext:
Shadow: Discard this minion to play a [wraith] minion from your discard pile.
Shadow: Spot 6 companions and discard this minion to play up to 2 [wraith] minions from your draw deck; their twilight costs are each -1.

effects.text: Play {wraith} minion from your discard pile
Play up to two {wraith} minions from draw deck

title: Streaming to the Field
gametext:
For each [wraith] Orc you can spot, the Free Peoples player must have an additional card in hand to have initiative.
Skirmish: Discard this condition to make a [wraith] Orc strength +2.
lore: They had been mustered....

title: Úlairë Attëa
gametext:
Enduring.
Regroup: Exert Úlairë Attëa and spot your [wraith] minion to return that minion to your hand.
lore: 'They are looking for something, surely?'
subtitle: Thrall of The One

title: Úlairë Nertëa
gametext:
Enduring. Fierce.
The site number of each [wraith] minion is -1.
lore: ...into their minds a blackness came, and they thought no more of war, but only of hiding and of crawling, and of death.
subtitle: Thrall of The One

title: Úlairë Otsëa
gametext:
Enduring. Fierce.
Regroup: Discard Úlairë Otsëa to add (X), where X is the current site number.
lore: Another long screech rose and fell, and he threw himself back again from the wall, panting like a hunted animal.
subtitle: Thrall of The One

title: Unhindered
gametext: Make a Nazgûl strength +2. If that Nazgûl wins this skirmish, the Shadow has initiative until the end of the turn, regardless of the Free Peoples player's hand.
lore: 'No living man may hinder me!'

title: Winged Mount
gametext:
To play, discard 2 cards from hand. Bearer must be a Nazgûl.
Response: If bearer is about to take a wound, remove a threat to prevent that wound.
lore: A creature of an older world maybe it was....

title: The Witch-king
gametext:
Enduring.
Each Man skirmishing The Witch-king loses all strength bonuses from weapons.
lore: 'Do not stop the attack until the City is taken.'
subtitle: Black Captain

title: Charged Headlong
gametext: If you have initiative, discard a [rohan] possession to play a [rohan] possession from your discard pile.
lore: ...and the black serpent foundered.

title: Doom Drove Them
gametext:
Fellowship: Exert a [rohan] companion and either a [gondor] Man or a [shire] companion to add a [rohan] token here.
Skirmish: Remove a [rohan] token here to exert a minion skirmishing a companion.
lore: Sea-kings' city in the South-kingdom / foe- beleaguered, fire-encircled.

title: Éomer
gametext:
Valiant.
When you play Éomer (except in your starting fellowship), you may reveal the top 10 cards of your draw deck. You may play each [rohan] possession revealed. Shuffle your draw deck.
lore: 'Need brooks no delay, yet late is better than never....'
subtitle: Keeper of Oaths

title: Éowyn's Shield
gametext:
Bearer must be a [rohan] Man.
The minion archery total is -1.
Skirmish: If bearer is Éowyn, add a threat and discard Éowyn's Shield to discard a hand weapon borne by a minion she is skirmishing.
lore: '...spear shall be shaken, shield shall be splintered....'

title: Fury of the Northmen
gametext: Exert a minion skirmishing a mounted [rohan] Man.
lore: 'Death! Ride, ride to ruin and the world's ending!'

title: No Living Man
gametext: Exert Théoden to exert a minion for each Théoden signet you spot.
lore: 'Begone, foul dwimmerlaik, lord of carrion!'

title: Rohirrim Army
gametext:
To play, spot 3 [rohan] companions.
You may play Rohirrim Army any time you could play a regroup event.
When you play Rohirrim Army, you may discard a minion.
lore: ...like a storm upon the plain and a thunder in the mountains.

title: Théoden
gametext:
Valiant.
While you can spot a [rohan] Man, Théoden's twilight cost is -1.
When Théoden is killed, you may play a [rohan] companion from your discard pile or draw deck.
lore: 'Up Eorlingas! Fear no darkness!'

texts: Play a {rohan} companion from discard pile
Play a {rohan} companion from draw deck

subtitle: Tall and Proud

title: Called Away
gametext: Regroup: Discard a [sauron] minion, spot a companion (except the Ring-bearer), and remove X burdens, where X is that companion's vitality, to return that companion to its owner's hand.
lore: 'Thus the will of Sauron has entered into Minas Tirith; and thus I have been delayed here.'

title: Gorgoroth Agitator
gametext:
Besieger. To play, spot a [sauron] Orc.
When you play this minion, if you can spot another besieger, you may add a threat for each companion over 4.
Shadow: Remove a threat to play a [sauron] engine from your discard pile.

title: Gorgoroth Assassin
gametext:
Besieger.
Assignment: Spot a [sauron] engine or a site you control to assign this minion to an unbound companion.
lore: ...filled with malice, hating even their own kind....

title: Gorgoroth Berserker
gametext:
Besieger. Enduring. To play, spot a [sauron] Orc.
Maneuver: If you have initiative, exert this minion twice to take control of a site.
Maneuver: Remove a threat and exert this minion twice to take control of a site.

effects.text: Exert this minion twice to take control of a site
Remove a threat and exert this minion twice to take control of a site

title: Gorgoroth Breaker
gametext:
Besieger.
Archery: Exert this minion or stack it on a site you control to make the fellowship archery total -2.
lore: 'The City is all set about with flame, and the field is full of foes.'

texts: Stack this minion on a site you control

title: Gorgoroth Looter
gametext:
Besieger.
When you play this minion, you may remove a burden to play a besieger stacked on a site you control.
lore: ...the hosts of Mordor were enheartened, and filled with a new lust and fury they came yelling....

title: Gorgoroth Patrol
gametext:
Besieger.
Regroup: If this minion is stacked on a site you control, discard this minion to make the move limit for this turn -1.
lore: ...new strength came now streaming to the field out of Osgiliath.

title: Gorgoroth Servitor
gametext:
Besieger.
Archery: Return this minion to your hand to make the fellowship archery total -2 and prevent the Free Peoples player from using archery special abilities.
lore: ...hurrying orcs were digging... just out of bowshot from the walls....

title: Gorgoroth Stormer
gametext:
Besieger.
Shadow: If you have initiative, exert this minion to add a burden and make the Free Peoples player draw a card.
lore: '...they found the enemy already on the out-wall, or assailing it....'

title: Great Hill Troll
gametext:
Besieger. Fierce.
The twilight cost of this minion is -1 for each [sauron] engine you spot.
When you play this minion at sites 5[K] to 9[K], you may discard a Free Peoples condition.
lore: ...and wielded heavy hammers in their knotted hands.

title: Grond
gametext:
Engine.
Shadow: Play a [sauron] minion to add a [sauron] token here.
Regroup: Remove X [sauron] tokens here to discard a Free Peoples card (except a companion) with a twilight cost of X. Discard a [sauron] minion or this possession.
subtitle: Hammer of the Underworld

title: Morgai
gametext:
While you can spot a [sauron] minion at site 5[K], the Shadow has initiative, regardless of the Free Peoples player's hand.
Response: If a companion is played, discard a [sauron] card from hand to take control of a site. Discard this condition.

title: Olog-hai of Mordor
gametext:
Besieger. Fierce.
The twilight cost of this minion is -2 for each [sauron] minion stacked on a site.
Each time this minion wins a skirmish, you may play a besieger stacked on a site you control. That besieger is fierce and damage +1 until the regroup phase.

title: Siege Troop
gametext:
Besieger.
Regroup: Exert this minion twice to take control of a site.
lore: ...yet still driven as if by a madness....

title: Their Marching Companies
gametext:
Engine. To play, spot a [sauron] minion.
Regroup: Remove a threat to stack your [sauron] minion on a site you control.
Shadow: Remove a threat to play a [sauron] minion stacked on a site you control.
lore: ...and soon yet more companies of the enemy were swiftly setting up....

title: Troll of Gorgoroth
gametext:
Besieger. Fierce. To play, spot a [sauron] Orc.
The twilight cost of Troll of Gorgoroth is -2 for each [sauron] engine you spot.
Regroup: Exert Troll of Gorgoroth to stack your besieger on a site you control.
lore: ...they could endure the Sun, so long as the will of Sauron held sway over them.
subtitle: Abomination of Sauron

title: Closer and Closer He Bent
gametext: Regroup: Exert an unbound Hobbit and add a burden to reveal your hand. Place each Free Peoples card revealed this way beneath your draw deck.
lore: Pippin sat with his knees drawn up and the ball between them. He bent low over it, looking like a greedy child stooping over a bowl of food.

title: Morgai Foothills
gametext:
When the fellowship moves from site 4[K], remove (1) for each Ring-bound companion you spot.
Regroup: Discard a card from hand for each Ring-bound companion you spot. Discard this condition.

title: So Fair, So Desperate
gametext: If the Shadow has initiative, add a threat to make an unbound Hobbit strength +1 for each [shire] card you spot.
lore: She should not die.... At least she should not die alone, unaided.

title: Song of the Shire
gametext:
Fellowship: Exert a [shire] companion and either a [rohan] companion or a [gandalf] companion to add a [shire] token here.
Skirmish: Remove a [shire] token here to prevent an unbound companion from being overwhelmed unless his or her strength is tripled.

title: Sting
gametext:
Bearer must be Frodo or Sam.
Response: If a fierce skirmish involving bearer is about to end, add a threat to discard a minion involved in that skirmish.
lore: No such anguish had Shelob ever known, or dreamed of knowing....
subtitle: Bane of the Eight Legs

title: Straining Towards Us
gametext: Exert Frodo to remove (1) for each Frodo signet you spot.
lore: '...blind almost to all else that is moving. So we must keep it. Therein lies all our hope.'

title: Unheeded
gametext: If a minion exerts, exert an unbound Hobbit to wound that minion.
lore: ...and passing up beneath the hauberk had pierced the sinew behind his mighty knee.

title: We Shall Meet Again Soon
gametext: If the fellowship moves during the regroup phase, exert an unbound Hobbit to place a Shadow card from your discard pile on top of your draw deck.
lore: 'He said: "Who are you?" I still did not answer, but it hurt me horribly; and he pressed me, so I said: "A hobbit."'

title: The Dimholt
gametext: Underground. Sanctuary. Fellowship: Add 3 threats to play an enduring companion from your draw deck.

title: City of the Dead
gametext: Underground. Shadow: Remove 2 burdens to play an enduring minion from your draw deck or discard pile.

texts: Play enduring minion from draw deck
Play enduring minion from discard pile

title: Crashed Gate
gametext: At the start of the regroup phase, the Free Peoples player must add 3 threats or choose an opponent who may take control of a site.

texts: Choose an opponent to take control of a site

true.text: Would you like to take control of a site?

title: Osgiliath Channel
gametext: River. Regroup: Spot your minion and 6 companions to make the Free Peoples player choose to move again this turn.

title: Merry
gametext:
To play, spot a [rohan] companion.
Skirmish: Discard 4 cards from hand to make Merry strength +2 for each [rohan] companion you spot.
lore: King's man! King's man!' his heart cried within him.
subtitle: Noble Warrior

title: Pippin
gametext:
To play, spot a [gondor] Man.
Skirmish: Discard 4 cards from hand to wound a minion Pippin is skirmishing twice if that minion bears a fortification.
lore: 'You're in the service of the Steward of Gondor now. You'll do as you're told.'
subtitle: Guard of Minas Tirith
